record.question: The AC system is preferred to DC system because
options: AC voltages can be easily changed in magnitude
DC motors do not have fine speed control
High-voltage AC transmission is less efficient
DC voltages cannot be used for domestic appliances
record.explanation: AC is preferred primarily because transformers can easily step up voltage for efficient long-distance transmission and step it down for domestic use. This flexibility is not possible with DC.
